bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError
base="http://127.0.0.1:8876/internal/tumblr"
key=Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
assert key.is_file() and len(key.read_text().strip()) >= 32, "BRIDGE_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED"
def post(path, data, secret):
    req=Request(path,json.dumps(data).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Authorization":"Bearer "+secret},method="POST")
    try:
        with urlopen(req,timeout=10) as response:return response.status,json.load(response)
    except HTTPError as error:return error.code,json.load(error)
status,_=post(base,{"action":"authorize","destination":"1"},"wrong-token")
assert status==401, ("WRONG_KEY_ADMISSION",status)
status,body=post(base,{"action":"authorize","destination":"1"},key.read_text().strip())
assert status==400 and body.get("error")=="TOPIC_NOT_VERIFIED",("VALID_KEY_TEST_FAILED",status,body)
cmd=["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc","SELECT topic_id FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 1"]
topic=subprocess.check_output(cmd,text=True,timeout=10).strip()
assert topic.isdecimal(), "NO_VERIFIED_ANNOUNCEMENT_TOPIC"
status,body=post(base,{"action":"authorize","destination":topic},key.read_text().strip())
assert status==200 and body.get("authorized") is True,("REAL_TOPIC_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED",status,body)
with urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8081/healthz",timeout=8) as r:
    app=json.load(r)
assert app.get("service")=="tumblr-operation-app"
assert app.get("commit")=="f3a160603d0cbac8154899e907d7a1e491be0a2c",app
print("LOCAL_BOT_AUTH_AND_TOPIC=PASS")
print("TUMBLR_RUNTIME_SHA=PASS")
PY
